Paperwork queues, a clear notice overnight
We write to travelers
Companion Animal Travel Desk Notice

Travelers with companion animals should review their documents before check-in and keep all health records ready. This helps the Aurelia Skyways process stay smooth and reduces delays at the counter.

Please follow the desk guidance for carriers, comfort items, and handover steps. <<FACT F019>> Keep your pet travel papers together, and confirm the route details before you arrive.

The Companion Animal Travel Desk can help with forms, packing guidance, and arrival support. <<FACT F007>> Bring any needed paperwork to the desk so staff can review it with you.

Please speak with the Companion Animal Travel Desk for direct help.
